parsed.summary: The netlist implements the specified CF-Chef architecture and key values: TPS2121 power mux, AP63203WU 3.3 V buck, TPS1H200 high-side heater switch, three MAX31855 SPI thermocouple channels, two fan-tach inputs with TVS protection, USB-C/ESP32-C3, and a WS2812 status LED. Reference designators differ from the specification, but the connectivity and passive values match the intended design; documented known limitations are present and no additional electrical deviation is supported by the files.
